name: Sandcastle
description: The one with a whole sandcastle to climb, from the beach outside its gate to the flag on its keep, inside, outside and over the roof. 1 Beach: hop the dunes (apple 1 over the second), then kick off the bank over the moat to the gate (2); short, you land in the ford and ride back out. 2 Gate hall, east: hop the rubble heap (3), ride down into the flooded cistern (4). 3 Tower: ride up the quarter pipe, which throws you back onto the great hall's ledge (5), and turn, in the air or on the ledge. 4 Great hall, west: kick over the hole above the cistern (6) and the hole above the rubble; a miss drops you to the gate hall to ride round again. Climb the dais (7). 5 Bridge: kick up, hang from the bastion's lip and pull up (8), turn, roll down and kick across to the gallery balcony; short, you land on the bridge and try again. 6 Gallery, east: kick over two holes, holding speed for 9 high over the second. Hop the pillows (10) and climb the stairs, lifting the front at each step. 7 Ride up the keep (11 beside the flower, which isn't open yet). Roll back down for speed and the kicker on the landing throws you over the stairwell onto the roof (12); too slow, you fall onto the stairs. Ride the battlements west, kicking over the hole in the roof (13; a miss drops you onto the pillows), to the west tower (14). Turn, ride back and drop into the stairwell to climb the stairs again, or come fast off the last hump and fly it back to the landing. 8 Over the keep, brake down its curled side to the terrace on the arches (15 at the far end), turn, and use the whole terrace as a run-up: only real speed carries you up the curl to the flower. Experts: reach the first pillow at about 450 units/s and it throws you over the second onto the third. The stairwell jump needs about 400. A miss inside drops you a floor and costs time rather than the run.
lesson: A long climb through a sandcastle that strings the career together: kicker jumps over holes, an air turn up a quarter pipe, a ledge hang, hops, steps and a momentum climb to the finish. Most misses drop you a floor and cost time rather than the run.
alsoNew: The coast backdrop and palms, and the beach: crabs, bunting, pennants, shells pressed into the walls and a beach ball to push around. A castle drawn with terrain, open to the sky through its arches, with a portcullis, a flooded cistern and a keep on arches over the sea.
